releaseNotes:
v1.4.12 - Fix Bible empty + Remove Privacy Policy from sidebar

Fixed: Bible content was empty because pubspec.yaml did not include subdirectories (ANY/OT/ and ANY/NT/). Now all 66 books load properly.

Removed: Privacy Policy item from sidebar drawer.

Bible (Weel Jwok) features:
- 66 books in Dha Anywaa (39 OT + 27 NT)
- Browse by OT/NT tabs, book selection, chapter grid
- Verse reading with verse numbers and section headings
- Audio playback per chapter (requires internet)
- Continue reading banner remembers last position
- Previous/Next chapter navigation
- Home screen shortcut
